content:
erica: Quick sync re: Nimbus hardware + IntegrateX SI marketplace listing and joint GTM. Need alignment on press embargo, landing page owner, and a minimal ops checklist.

sam_pm: TL;DR: coordinated marketplace publish + co-authored blog + single press quote. Target launch in ~2 weeks (T+14).

mike_engineering: Technical needs: verify SKU mapping, webhook flow, and partner-specific IAM roles. I can run an end-to-end smoke in our staging marketplace tomorrow 10:00 PT.

anita_prod: Landing page owner? Also need copy freeze for localization by Friday EOD.

erica: Julia will own landing page and hero asset signoff; Anita will own copy freeze. Julia - confirm hero formats (png/webp/svg) and sizes?

julia_marketing: Confirmed. PNG + WebP + SVG logo. Primary hero 1200x600. ETA Thu 12:00 PT, I'll upload to /shared/marketplace/nimbus and tag.

mike_engineering: For IntegrateX, they need the onboarding manifest and example deploy script. I'll drop a template today. Also we should confirm API rate limits to avoid listing throttles.

sam_pm: Embargo plan? We should pick a single public embargo. Partners provide quotes for co-author blog and press release.

press_ops_bot: Suggested embargo: 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC. Automated reminders will be sent 48h prior.

anita_prod: Legal prefers 09:00 PT. Can partners do that?

erica: Nimbus confirmed 09:00 PT. IntegrateX prefers 11:00 PT; propose public embargo 09:00 PT and offer a partner pre-brief at 11:00 PT.

sam_pm: Agree. Public embargo fixed at 09:00 PT; optional partner pre-brief at 11:00 PT.

julia_marketing: Blog plan: co-authored post with one partner customer quote. Draft by Monday; need partner quotes by Friday COB.

mike_engineering: Ops checklist (short):
```
- validate SKU mapping in staging
- run webhook retry and latency test
- confirm IAM role mapping for partner installs
- smoke test model inference end-to-end (≤60s cold start)
- verify logs routing to partner telemetry
```
I'll post results after the 10:00 smoke tomorrow.

erica: Who publishes the marketplace listing? Redwood or partner-managed?

anita_prod: Redwood will publish the initial listing; partner approves via their console. Legal signoff required on T&Cs.

sam_pm: Action items: Julia (landing & hero assets) by Thu 12:00 PT, Mike (smoke + IntegrateX template) tomorrow, Anita (copy freeze & legal) by Friday, Erica (partner coordination + embargo confirm) today. I'll compile press release + collect quotes.

julia_marketing: Adding promo banner for launch: will include special promotional SKU CTA for first 30 days. Uploading assets and copy snippets to the shared drive.

anita_prod: Add promo SKU to manifest; promo period T+0 to T+30.

erica: We'll run a 15-min partner dry run on launch morning to validate links, quote attribution, telemetry. Who needs to be on it?

mike_engineering: I'll join for telemetry and final smoke check.

sam_pm: I'll handle press coordination on the call.

anita_prod: I'll join to validate copy and flows.

erica: Great. If no blockers after tomorrow's smoke, I'll lock timeline and send partner confirmation. :thumbsup:
